description: Read-only XRPL issued-asset exposure calculation for one issuing account. `account` is the required XRPL issuer address; optionally use `hotwallet` with one address or a list of operational hot-wallet addresses when those balances should be included in the calculation, and use `ledger_index` to pin the calculation to a specific ledger. `strict` controls how account identifiers are interpreted. The result reports the calculated issued-asset exposure without modifying the ledger, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for issuer-level issued-asset exposure; do not use it for trust-line holdings of a single account, where n9t2_xrpl_list_account_lines is the appropriate tool.

account.description: XRPL issuing account whose issued-asset balances should be calculated.
account.title: Account

hotwallet.description: Optional XRPL hot-wallet account address or list of hot-wallet addresses.
hotwallet.title: Hotwallet

ledger_index.description: Optional ledger index or selector for the balance calculation.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

strict.description: Whether account identifiers should be interpreted strictly as supplied.
strict.title: Strict

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_gateway_balances
